name: unity-skillforge
description: Skills for building Unity 2D, 2.5D and 3D games with the Unity CLI, plus the design-document workflow they depend on.

interface.longDescription: Design-first Unity game development: write the design docs, build core architecture, then the 2D, 2.5D or 3D skills for your project, with generated-asset pipelines and a QA loop driven by the Unity CLI.
defaultPrompt: Turn this pitch into a Unity game design: a 2D platformer about a courier in a storm.
Set up an isometric 2.5D camera and fix my sprite sorting.
Add a dash mechanic to my 3D character controller and verify it in play mode.
